title: Warm Welsh-Style Potted Shepherds Pie with Dates
description: A rich, herbal, and silky British dish featuring pitted dates, perfect for a solo dinner. This diabetic-friendly version of the classic shepherds pie is served in a tandoor clay pot.

ingredients.name: Pitted dates (12 oz)
ingredients.notes: Medjool or Deglet dates work well.

ingredients.name: Braised lamb shoulder (1.5 lbs)
ingredients.notes: Use a slow cooker for tender results.

ingredients.name: Onion (1 medium)
ingredients.notes: Chopped onion adds depth to the dish.

ingredients.name: Garlic (3 cloves)
ingredients.notes: Minced garlic is a classic ingredient.

ingredients.name: Fresh thyme (1 sprig)
ingredients.notes: Thyme is a staple herb in Welsh cuisine.

ingredients.name: All-purpose flour (2 tbsp)
ingredients.notes: Dredge lamb in flour for crispy texture.

ingredients.name: Olive oil (2 tbsp)
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality olive oil for flavor.

ingredients.name: Chicken broth (1 cup)
ingredients.notes: Low-sodium broth keeps the dish diabetic-friendly.

ingredients.name: Red wine (1 cup)
ingredients.notes: A small amount of red wine adds depth.

ingredients.name: Mashed sweet potato (2 large)
ingredients.notes: Sweet potatoes are a great source of fiber.

ingredients.name: Grated cheddar cheese (1 cup)
ingredients.notes: A sprinkle of cheese adds richness.

ingredients.name: Salt and pepper to taste
ingredients.notes: Season to taste for the perfect balance.

instructions: Brown the lamb in a skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Transfer the lamb to a slow cooker and add the chopped onion, minced garlic, fresh thyme, and fresh rosemary. Cook on low for 6 hours or high for 3 hours.
Strain the lamb mixture and discard the solids. Add the all-purpose flour and chicken broth, stirring to combine.
Return the lamb mixture to the slow cooker and add the red wine. Simmer for an additional 30 minutes.
While the lamb mixture cooks, prepare the mashed sweet potatoes. Boil or bake the sweet potatoes until tender, then mash with butter and milk.
To assemble the shepherds pie, transfer the lamb mixture to a tandoor clay pot or individual ramekins. Top with mashed sweet potatoes and grated cheddar cheese.
Bake the pie in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
